attributes.name: syncCount
attributes.description: Number of synchronizations of ForceContainer (cummulative); if significantly higher than number of steps, there might be unnecessary syncs hurting performance.

methods.name: f
methods.description: Resultant force on body, excluding gravity<NewtonIntegrator.gravity>. For clumps in openMP, synchronize the force container with sync=True, else the value will be wrong.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Torque applied on body. For clumps in openMP, synchronize the force container with sync=True, else the value will be wrong.

methods.name: addF
methods.description: Apply force on body (accumulates). The force applies for one iteration, then it is reset by ForceResetter.

methods.name: addT
methods.description: Apply torque on body (accumulates). The torque applies for one iteration, then it is reset by ForceResetter.

methods.name: permF
methods.description: read the value of permanent force on body (set with setPermF()).

methods.name: permT
methods.description: read the value of permanent torque on body (set with setPermT()).

methods.name: setPermF
methods.description: set the value of permanent force on body.

methods.name: setPermT
methods.description: set the value of permanent torque on body.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Reset the force container, including user defined permanent forces/torques. resetAll=False will keep permanent forces/torques unchanged.

methods.name: getPermForceUsed
methods.description: Check wether permanent forces are present.
